name: ai-game-studio-blender
description: An opt-in, pinned Blender MCP adapter and safety workflow for Codex AI Game Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and operate one pinned Blender MCP safely.
interface.longDescription: Detects Blender, plans the ahujasid Blender MCP adapter, checks conflicts and permissions, and requires confirmation before setup or scene writes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-game-studio-blender:setup-blender to inspect Blender and propose a pinned setup. Do not change anything yet.
